title: Empty Else branch
description:
Error-prone rule — an Else immediately followed by End If, i.e. an Else branch with no steps. Usually a leftover.

Based on the PMD rule EmptyControlStatement — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_codestyle.html#emptycontrolstatement
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: An empty Else adds a branch that does nothing and hides intent.
rule.remediation: Remove the empty Else or fill in the intended steps.
